test.result: 28 passed across fixed-look and paper-account bridge suites; Ruff and mypy passed. Risk-stop integration test reopens the account after a halt and confirms subsequent strategy, risk approval and execution callbacks remain blocked.

implemented: The policy freezes ordered session-count looks, familywise alpha, drawdown harm floor and freeze timestamps into a content hash.
Unscheduled efficacy views return no efficacy decision; alpha is divided across registered looks.
Risk harm stops at any observation, including between looks; missing risk evidence fails closed.
The module reports order permission semantics without granting permission at efficacy checkpoints.

ForwardPaperSessionService accepts a validated optional fixed-look risk-stop callback, persists a harm stop to the append-only account risk latch before strategy evaluation, and records the stop report with the runner risk verdict. Account replay preserves the latch across restart.
blockers: No authoritative trial registry persists the fixed-look policy or automatically supplies the risk-stop callback to production sessions.
The fixed-look schedule is not joined to sample-size design or prospective performance evidence; no live result is claimed.
